desc: Prove that for \(k \ge 4\), an answer greater than `side` is impossible.
Reduce feasibility for \(d \le side\) to selecting cyclic perimeter coordinates with every consecutive circular gap at least \(d\).
Implement duplicated-perimeter greedy feasibility checking with closing-gap validation.
Binary search the maximum feasible distance in `O(n * k * log(side))`.
